Snickers Dessert
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 11:38pm

Ingredients




1 qt. or 12 oz. ice milk (vanilla)
1/4 cup peanut butter
1/2 cup or 3 oz. Grapenut cereal
1 cup Cool Whip (Lite)
1 sm. pkg. sugar-free pudding (cooked type) chocolate





Preparation

1 Mix all ingredients with electric mixer and pour into an 8 x 8 inch pan and freeze. Before serving, top with a little more Cool Whip. It is very rich. Serves 6 to 8.
